title: Matrix product verification acceptance probability
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a probability density on the $n$-dimensional vector space over the field with two elements, and let $A$, $B$, and $C$ be $n\times n$ matrices over that field. Define the acceptance probability as the expectation under $\varphi$ of the indicator of the event $Cx=A(Bx)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a probability density on the binary vector space of dimension $n$
$A,B,C$ are matrices indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(n)\times\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ over the field with two elements
